description: This file defines data structures related to online multiplayer lobby state and events for a Dart/Flutter project, including the 'LobbyState' class and various 'OnlineEvent' subclasses.

classes.name: LobbyState
classes.description: Represents the state of a lobby session or matchmaking queue, capturing connection status, match search status, error messages, and session ID.

classes.name: OnlineEvent
classes.description: A sealed superclass for minimal server-to-client online play events.

classes.name: OnlineEventConnected
classes.description: Event indicating successful connection to the server.

classes.name: OnlineEventDisconnected
classes.description: Event indicating disconnection from the server.

classes.name: OnlineEventMatchFound
classes.description: Event indicating a match has been found, containing the session ID.

classes.name: OnlineEventStateSync
classes.description: Event containing state synchronization payload from server.

classes.name: OnlineEventError
classes.description: Event indicating an error with a message.

methods.name: LobbyState.initial
methods.description: Factory constructor to create an initial default lobby state.

methods.name: LobbyState.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current LobbyState with optional modifications.
